question.text: What certification is required for a person to become a mutual fund distributor in India?

answer.text: NISM Series V-A or V-B Mutual Fund certification

explanation.text: The Logic: Regular mutual fund distributors require the NISM Series V-A: Mutual Fund Distributors Certification. New-cadre distributors can use the NISM Series V-B: Mutual Fund Foundation Certification to sell a limited, specified set of schemes. After passing the applicable certification, the distributor must register with AMFI to obtain an ARN and renew it on time. The Trap: CA, MBA or similar qualifications do not automatically authorise mutual fund distribution. The appropriate NISM certification is required, and the V-B route is restricted to the new cadre and its specified schemes. Note: The source also notes a CPE route in legacy cases for distributors who were 50+ years of age or had 10 years of relevant experience under earlier rules.
